records.issue_text: app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:145 drops the first hostname label when comparing domains, incorrectly treating unrelated registrable domains such as alice.co.uk and bob.co.uk as the same domain and displaying the full path incorrectly.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the domain comparison logic at line 145. The code `website_host.split('.')[1..-1].join('.') == discourse_host.split('.')[1..-1].join('.')` compares domains by dropping the first label, which would incorrectly treat unrelated domains like 'alice.co.uk' and 'bob.co.uk' as the same (both become 'co.uk').
